title: Walk-in || Quality Engineer
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 19 Sep - 25 Sep
Timing: 11.00 AM - 4.00 PM
Venue: 46/4/1, Site 4, Industrial Area, Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201010
Contact: Priya (9821804004)

Role & responsibilities 
 JOB DESCRIPTION QUALITY ENGINEER Position: Quality Engineer Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control
 Industry: Manufacturing Moulding, Fabrication & Electrical Components
 Experience: 2–5 Years
 Location: [Location]
 Reporting To: Quality Manager / Head – Quality 1. JOB PURPOSE To ensure that raw materials, in-process production, and finished products meet defined quality standards, customer specifications, drawings, and company requirements. The Quality Engineer will be responsible for implementing quality systems, identifying and resolving quality issues, reducing rejection and rework, and continuously improving manufacturing processes. The candidate should have practical knowledge of plastic moulding, fabrication processes, and electrical components . 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Incoming Quality Control Inspect incoming raw materials, bought-out components, electrical components, and fabricated parts. Verify materials against approved specifications, drawings, purchase requirements, and inspection standards. Conduct dimensional, visual, functional, and material inspections as applicable. Maintain incoming inspection records and supplier quality documentation. Identify and report non-conforming materials and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers. B. In-Process Quality Control Monitor quality at various stages of manufacturing, including:
 Plastic injection moulding Fabrication Assembly Electrical component assembly Other production processes as applicable. Conduct first-piece, patrol, and final inspections. Ensure critical dimensions and process parameters are maintained. Monitor moulding defects such as short moulding, sink marks, flash, warpage, burn marks, flow marks, and dimensional variation. Inspect fabricated components for dimensional accuracy, welding quality, surface finish, holes, bends, and assembly accuracy. Check electrical components for correct specifications, assembly, connections, and functionality. C. Final Quality Inspection Inspect finished products according to approved drawings, specifications, control plans, and customer requirements. Ensure products are released only after meeting defined quality standards. Prepare inspection reports and maintain quality records. Support dispatch clearance and customer-specific inspection requirements. D. Quality Documentation Prepare and maintain:
 Inspection Reports First Piece Inspection Reports In-Process Inspection Records Final Inspection Reports Control Plans Check Sheets Corrective & Preventive Action (CAPA) records Rejection and rework reports Maintain proper traceability of quality records. E. Problem Solving & Corrective Action Identify root causes of internal and customer quality issues. Use quality tools such as:
 5 Why Analysis Fishbone / Ishikawa Analysis Pareto Analysis 8D Problem Solving PDCA Implement corrective and preventive actions. Follow up to ensure effectiveness of corrective actions. F. Moulding Quality Monitor injection moulding processes and identify moulding-related defects. Coordinate with production and mould maintenance teams for quality issues related to moulds, machines, and process parameters. Verify critical moulding parameters such as temperature, pressure, cycle time, cooling time, and other applicable settings. Support trial and validation of new moulds and process changes. I. Supplier & Customer Quality Coordinate with suppliers regarding quality issues and corrective actions. Support supplier development and incoming quality improvement. Handle customer complaints and assist in preparing corrective action reports. Coordinate with production, purchase, design, and other departments for resolution of quality issues. J. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to reduce rejection, rework, scrap, and customer complaints. Participate in quality improvement and process improvement projects. Monitor quality KPIs and prepare periodic quality reports. Promote quality awareness among production and shop-floor employees. 3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE The candidate should have working knowledge of: Plastic Injection Moulding moulding defects Fabrication Electrical components and assemblies Engineering drawings Measuring instruments Vernier Caliper & Micrometer Height Gauge Gauges and other inspection equipmentt Quality Control Plans Process Inspection Root Cause Analysis CAPA / 8D 5 Why & Fishbone Analysis Basic SPC concepts 7 QC Tools ISO 9001 quality systems 4. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Electrical, or related engineering discipline . Additional certification in Quality Management will be an advantage. 5. EXPERIENCE 2–5 years of experience in Quality Control / Quality Assurance in a manufacturing environment. Experience in plastic moulding, fabrication, electrical components, or similar manufacturing processes preferred. Candidates with hands-on shop-floor quality experience will be preferred. 6. KEY SKILLS Strong inspection and analytical skills Knowledge of manufacturing processes Problem-solving and root-cause analysis Good knowledge of engineering drawings Good communication and coordination skills Attention to detail Ability to work independently on the shop floor Knowledge of MS Excel and quality documentation Ability to coordinate with Production, Purchase, Maintenance, Design, and Suppliers Strong focus on quality improvement and defect reduction 7. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Reduction in internal rejection and rework Reduction in customer complaints First Pass Yield (FPY) Incoming material rejection rate Process rejection rate Corrective action closure time Supplier quality performance Inspection accuracy and documentation compliance Reduction in scrap and quality-related costs

Key Skills: Quality Check,Quality Inspection,PDI,Final Inspection,InProcess Inspection,Incoming Inspection,Quality Control
